name: zdi_set_material_flag_bit9_for_flag_bit0_entries
description: zDi::SetMaterialFlagBit9ForFlagBit0Entries walks display-instance entries and applies material flag bit 9 only to entries whose material already has flag bit 8 set.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; final byte matching should be handled with the coherent zModel/zClass material source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4841b0 validates entryCount iteration, 0x1c-byte zDiEntry stride, material pointer load at entry+0x14, flag-bit-8 gating through material->flags byte 1 bit 0, and forwarding the requested enabled value to zModel_Material::SetFlagBit9.
The native smoke verifies flag-bit-9 is applied to materials with flag bit 8 set and skipped for materials without flag bit 8.
